sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior valid instruction: airReceiverCapacity is still enforced only by presence and is never related to the charging-time constraint. Add a bounded direct relationship or registered comparison/formula that actually uses the declared airReceiverCapacity value together with compressorChargeTime and the applicable 0.5-hour or 1-hour limit; do not check compressorChargeTime alone. Keep both terms ship-owned with their canonical QuantityValue units.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The candidate omits the declared required input airReceiverCapacity_Nm3, so it does not faithfully encode the requirement that compressor capacity be sufficient to charge the receivers from atmospheric to full pressure.
